answer: Each new agent opens one lotus commitment: a 60 POA bond plus a hash-chained attestation thread that must be extended every epoch with a fresh signature over the prior receipt. Extending the thread also requires solving a yarrow puzzle whose leading-zero bits rise by 2 for every extra identity that shares the operator's cluster fingerprint. A reused or stalled thread burns 25% of the bond. One honest agent pays 60 POA once and one puzzle per epoch; a thousand clones pay 60,000 POA locked and face puzzles too hard to keep all threads alive.
